product.description: The TerraGrip Garden Fork 8 is engineered for robust soil manipulation and efficient digging. Its 60‑cm long steel tines provide a wide cutting edge, while the ergonomic rubber handle offers a secure grip during prolonged use. Designed for both home gardens and small farms, the fork resists rust and corrosion, thanks to a protective powder‑coat finish. The lightweight yet sturdy construction allows for easy maneuvering around raised beds, compost piles, and lawn beds. Ideal for planting, turning, and aerating, this tool delivers reliable performance across a range of soil types, from loamy to clay. The TerraGrip brand’s commitment to durability is evident in its 12‑month warranty and straightforward maintenance instructions.
